<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/rag/local"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Text content already read by the browser (`<input webkitdirectory>`), never a host path — that distinction is the whole point of ADR 0113. Idempotent full rebuild of the `local` scope: every call deletes and recreates it from the files sent THIS time, so re-uploading is the resync mechanism. Rejects (400) over the file-count/total-bytes caps instead of truncating silently — this is a one-shot user gesture with a folder picker in front of it, not a background scan. An individual oversized or unrecognized-extension file is only skipped, never fails the batch.
